spec_match.rationale: Shows that appendChild re-parenting is a removal (detachment events fire, the frame reloads), while moveBefore is atomic. This is the composition that avoids the deprecated path entirely.

interactive.rationale: Add-clicks, appendChild-move and moveBefore-move buttons with a move history table.

edge_cases.rationale: moveBefore is feature-detected with an explained disabled state, and an unexpected moveBefore reload is reported as such.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/<id> plus the spec/explainer sections it exercises.

conformance.rationale: Backed by the movebefore-replacement-exists typeof assertion.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: moveBefore kept 3 clicks with no events and no reload; appendChild fired pagehide/visibilitychange/unload synchronously, reloaded and reset clicks to 0; no console errors; 0px overflow.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts moveBefore preservation and appendChild detachment.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons override both background and color; verdict colours use emerald-dark/rose on stone; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: History is a real table with scope=col headers in a focusable labelled region; live verdict; titled iframe.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Docks stack on mobile; table wraps inside a scroll region; no page overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: iframe lifecycle pagehide visibilitychange unload deprecation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use Element.moveBefore() (feature-detected, insertBefore fallback) to reparent iframes without reload/state loss.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Used as the control row / advanced composition, feature-detected with an explained disabled state.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status live region announce async result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous results via polite live regions; keep native buttons/labels; visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts/outputs are role=status or aria-live=polite; all controls are native buttons/inputs with visible text labels and a 3px focus outline; min 44px targets.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic grid tracks (minmax(min(100%, Xrem), 1fr)) and wrap long monospace strings so nothing overflows at 360px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Card grids use minmax(min(100%,…),1fr); outputs use overflow-wrap:anywhere; measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3.

summary: Fully real today and verified: the clearest way to sidestep removal-time events.
